values: Implemented and tested. Keep optional because coverage is limited and RAM use is high.
Local installs only. Disabled by default. The hosted website has no background-removal control.
The fresh six all kept their original backgrounds. This demonstrates safe refusal, not successful removal.
The diagnostic set informed tuning. The combined rate is descriptive, not a general success-rate estimate.
CPU, 1024 × 1024, soft mask and local edge matting
Edge matting removed the visible pale halos in the accepted examples while preserving lettering and dots.
JPEG edges, thin outlines, ambiguous backgrounds and common black icons are often declined.
Prioritize broader useful coverage and lower RAM requirements before considering default-on use.
Sources: Local background-removal quality experiment and Independent background-removal QA, 8 Sep 2026.
